title: Product Guidelines & Standards
description: Define brand voice, UI/UX principles, and communication standards

questions.question: What is the primary visual style for the interface?
What is the preferred color theme?

options.label: Dark Mode
options.description: Dark backgrounds with light text (modern, reduces eye strain)

options.label: Light Mode
options.description: Light backgrounds with dark text (traditional, high contrast)

questions.question: What is the communication tone for messages and documentation?
How should error messages be presented?

options.label: Technical with Details
options.description: Show technical errors, stack traces, debug info

options.label: User-Friendly with Guidance
options.description: Plain language, suggest solutions, hide technical details

options.label: Hybrid (Role-Based)
options.description: Technical for engineers, user-friendly for operators

questions.question: Any specific design principles or guidelines to follow?
questions.placeholder:
Example:
- Clarity over aesthetics
- Consistent icons and buttons
- Generous spacing for touch interfaces
- Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance)
